panels.title: Estado de planta

targets.query: SELECT (FLOOR(last("value") / 2) % 2) * 1000 + (FLOOR(last("value") / 4) % 2 + FLOOR(last("value") / 8) % 2) * 100 + (last("value") % 2) * 10 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'estado' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Alarmas activas
panels.description: Alarmas no resueltas y la severidad máxima entre ellas.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  count(*) AS "Activas",
  COALESCE(max(CASE severity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 3 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END), 0) AS "Máx."
FROM alarms
WHERE state <> 'RESOLVED'

panels.title: Alarmas activas
panels.description: Alarmas no resueltas, ordenadas por severidad y antigüedad.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  severity::text AS "Severidad",
  variable AS "Variable",
  message AS "Mensaje",
  state::text AS "Estado",
  ts_active AS "Desde",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - ts_active) AS "Antigüedad"
FROM alarms
WHERE state <> 'RESOLVED'
ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, ts_active
LIMIT 8
